Family excursion in the Vordere Sächsische Schweiz
Interesting facts about mushrooms in the National Park region with a special guided tour for children with the mushroom experts Kerstin Aretz and Enrico Tomschke (German Society for Mycology). The meeting point will be announced when you register at the National Park Center Bad Schandau on 035022 50242.
